name: credential-verification-extension
description: Browser extension for one-click credential verification, local credential storage, web app sync, badge notifications, and form auto-fill.

scripts.build: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.build:chrome: npm run clean:chrome && cross-env TARGET=chrome vite build
scripts.build:firefox: npm run clean:firefox && cross-env TARGET=firefox vite build
scripts.package: npm run package:chrome && npm run package:firefox
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build:chrome && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome --artifacts-dir artifacts --filename chrome-extension-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir artifacts --filename firefox-extension-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest
